name: Control Center
subtitle: Remote for Control Center on your Mac

apps.name: Control Center
apps.subtitle: Control your Claude sessions from your phone
apps.localizedDescription: The iPhone remote for Control Center: see every task's status, answer questions, approve plans and start tasks on your Mac.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Themes: Glass, Terminal and Plain
- Editable keyboard shortcuts
- Import: list only interactive terminal sessions, read just the start of each file
- Terminal: pick your terminal app; sessions continued there mirror live into the app
- Split chats: drag task cards into panes, resizable, remembered across restarts

- Mac .dmg releases with in-app updates, iPhone via SideStore; done stays done
- Stop the repeated Keychain password prompt
- Question card: don't repeat a preview the question already contains
- Never ask to approve a draft the user can't see
- Questions as buttons, readable plans, reliable status and Stop
- Repos are proposed by Claude after a first look, then approved
- Projects & lazy worktrees in <root>/<project>/<repo>/<task>
- Shift+Tab permission modes, quick actions never land in the wrong repo, iPhone navigation
- iPhone: persist pairing explicitly so it survives reinstalls
- Phone notifications: clarify they are Control Center events only; no duplicates
- Notifications: guided ntfy setup with subscribe QR, auto topic, test with delivery status
- aico via claude.ai connector (OAuth), iPhone over LAN + installer, adaptive board
- iPhone remote, e2e driver, newest-claude resolution, unattended auto-fix, UI polish

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing QR code shown on your Mac.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect to Control Center running on your Mac.
